Pneumatized_Keel_Chassis.description: An incredibly light, rigid skeletal frame composed of hollow, strut-reinforced bones (pneumatization). It features a massively expanded sternum keel to anchor vast flight muscles, sacrificing brute durability for weightlessness and aerodynamic efficiency.

Ratite_Flightless_Core.description: A dense, un-keeled sternum and heavy, marrow-filled bones. Having abandoned the architectural requirements of flight entirely, this chassis is built to anchor massive cursorial leg muscles, turning the entity into a towering, high-speed terrestrial runner.
